# SmashR

> SmashR is a smash burger counter in Budapest, Hungary (1239 Budapest, Bevásárló u. 2.).
> Fresh, never-frozen beef is smashed once onto a hot flat-top so the edges crisp and the centre
> stays juicy. Short menu, made to order, eaten in paper. Tagline: WE SMASH. YOU EAT.

## Facts
- Address: 1239 Budapest, Bevásárló u. 2., Hungary
- Phone: +36 20 447 0900
- Opening hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00–20:45, Sunday 10:00–19:45
- Ordering: foodora and Wolt delivery. No table reservations.
- Menu: Classic Smash, House Smash, Crispy Bacon Smash, Crispy Chicken (double patty);
  Classic Smash Big, House Smash Big, Crispy Bacon Big Smash (triple patty, Wolt only);
  combo menus with fries and a soft drink; fries, loaded fries, mozzarella sticks; ketchup,
  mayonnaise; still and sparkling mineral water.

## Notes
- Prices shown on this site are taken from SmashR's own foodora and Wolt listings and can change
  there; the ordering platform always holds the current price.
- Product photography belongs to the restaurant. Nothing on the menu is an illustration.
